proof_review: Read the complete WeakMeasurableEvolution module. It constructs real extensions Y,A', joint along-path measurability, actual-map integral identities, B measurability and local bounds, hence global local integrability. Compact continuity gives g-integrability. For each terminal time it proves restricted time-first drift integrability and invokes the reviewed centered-balance theorem. Subtracting base identities yields signed two-time balance. The B bound gives LipschitzOnWith and then absolute continuity. Lebesgue differentiation of the primitive and local equality on Ioi 0 yield the full derivative a.e. positive time.

The full module also verifies the measurability and local-integrability preparation summarized in the first and third steps. Per-time exceptional events and the real extension convention are accurately stated.
